name: frameworks_request_clarification
description: Ask for clarification of a capability, one of its level expectations, or a role example (illustration) — opens a discussion, proposes nothing. `rationale` is Markdown: links, **bold**, _italic_, lists and `code` render, a bare URL becomes a link, typed HTML shows as text and images render as links.

capability_id.description: The capability to anchor on. Required unless illustration_id is given.

illustration_id.description: An example (role illustration) to anchor on — the most specific target, and its level is taken from the owning expectation. Required unless capability_id is given.
